description: This file implements a class and functions for simplifying loop conditions in an Abstract Syntax Tree (AST) as part of a shader compiler or translator. It transforms loop conditions into regular statements to facilitate further code transformations.

classes.name: SimplifyLoopConditionsTraverser
classes.description: A class that traverses an AST to identify and transform loop conditions for simplification.

methods.name: SimplifyLoopConditionsTraverser
methods.description: Constructor initializing the traverser with a mask for conditions to simplify and a symbol table.

methods.name: visitUnary
methods.description: Checks unary nodes for conditions to simplify when inside loop conditions or expressions.

methods.name: visitBinary
methods.description: Checks binary nodes for conditions to simplify when inside loop conditions or expressions.

methods.name: visitAggregate
methods.description: Checks aggregate nodes for conditions to simplify when inside loop conditions or expressions.

methods.name: visitTernary
methods.description: Checks ternary nodes for conditions to simplify when inside loop conditions or expressions.

methods.name: visitDeclaration
methods.description: Checks declaration nodes for conditions to simplify when inside loop conditions or expressions.

methods.name: traverseLoop
methods.description: Traverses and potentially transforms a loop node by hoisting loop conditions into separate variables and restructuring the loop.
